metadata.name: Mineral Composition and Sediment Depth Data
metadata.description: This dataset contains mineral composition and sediment depth data from a single location in the Pacific Ocean. It includes measurements of various minerals such as quartz, plagioclase, illite, chlorite, and others, along with sediment depth, latitude, longitude, elevation, and date/time information. The data is collected from 14 samples taken on May 30, 2021.
